manifest.name: dsh-thinking-cn
manifest.description: 中文思考 / Chinese Thinking for DeepSeek Harness: mounts the built-in experimental reasoning translation and pins it to Simplified Chinese, so expanded thinking blocks read in Chinese while the original stays one click away.
manifest.author: lzyxczw-cyber

bundle.text:
# 中文思考 / Chinese Thinking
#
# Mounts the harness's shipped experimental reasoning translation and pins its
# configuration to Simplified Chinese. The capability itself (provider clients,
# paragraph scheduling, session-cached results, the "View original" toggle) is
# the two official packages below; this package only composes their rows, so a
# user needs no extra translation service, account, or API key.
#
# `provider: bing` is the anonymous Microsoft Edge translation endpoint:
# no login and no per-fragment billing.
- insert:
    - id: translator
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator'
    - id: cot-translation
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-cot-translation'
      config:
        provider: bing
        targetLanguage: zh

readme.text:
[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Marketplace entry](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that makes the model's **expanded reasoning read in Simplified
Chinese**. It mounts the harness's shipped experimental reasoning translation
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` +
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-cot-translation`) and pins its configuration to
`provider: bing`, `targetLanguage: zh`.

This package is a configuration bundle: it ships no translation client of its own. The
translation itself — paragraph scheduling, the "View original" toggle, per-session result
storage — is the shipped experimental feature. Installing this bundle removes the manual
step of finding it in the Plugins page and switching its target language.

```sh
dsh plugin add github:lzyxczw-cyber/dsh-thinking-cn
```

Then restart the profile if your host asks. In DSH Desktop, open **Settings → Plugins →
Add**, paste the repository URL, and install from there.

The bundle requires a DSH build that ships the two experimental reasoning-translation
packages (the `0.2.1` line, `>=0.2.1-alpha.2 <0.3.0`).

1. Send any prompt that produces reasoning, then **expand the Think row**.
2. Completed paragraphs of the expanded body are translated into Simplified Chinese as
   they arrive; the unfinished tail stays in the original language.
3. The toolbar above the body switches between **View original** and **View translation**
   without another request.
4. Translations are stored as `plugin:translator/request` and `plugin:translator/result`
   records in the session, so collapsing and re-expanding, reloading the page, or
   restarting the host reuses them without calling the provider again.

Expanded reasoning is translated through the anonymous Microsoft Edge (Bing) endpoint:
no login, no API key, no per-fragment billing. The selected provider receives the source
text; the original reasoning stays in the session and in model input unchanged.

The defaults are defined in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change the provider
or target language without editing this package, override the row in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: cot-translation
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-cot-translation'
  config:
    provider: bing      # bing | google | deepseek-account | deepseek-official

`deepseek-account` / `deepseek-official` issue independent paid DeepSeek Flash requests and
need an already configured account or API credential. Anonymous endpoints never fall back
to another provider.

- Only the **expanded** body is translated; the collapsed one-line summary stays in the
  original language.
- Translation starts when a reasoning body is expanded, not while it is collapsed.
- Anonymous Bing/Google endpoints may rate-limit or become unavailable; a failure keeps the
  original body and offers Retry.
- Translated Markdown or code formatting may differ from the original; the original is
  always one click away.
- This bundle and the official **Reasoning translation** experiment mount the same two
  row ids. Keep only one of them active: if the official bundle is enabled later, enable
  that one's settings page and set the target language to `zh` instead of relying on this
  patch.

- DSH with the experimental reasoning-translation packages available to the loader
  (`0.2.1` line).
- The Web or Desktop GUI; the feature is a client-side view and does not change what the
  model sees.
MIT. Translation packages are shipped by DeepSeek under their own MIT license.
